problem:
The graph of $y=5f(3x-6)+2,$ can be obtained from the graph of $y=f(x)$ by applying **some** of the following transformations:

- $(\text{T}1)$ - Translate right by $6$ units

- $(\text{T}2)$ - Stretch by a scale factor of $\frac{1}{3}$ parallel to the $x$-axis

- $(\text{T}3)$ - Translate up by $2$ units

- $(\text{T}4)$ - Stretch by a scale factor of $5$ parallel to the $y$-axis

- $(\text{T}5)$ - Translate right by $2$ units

Which of the following could be a possible ordering of the appropriate transformations?

html:
Question 3

The graph of y=5f(3x−6)+2, can be obtained from the graph of y=f(x) by applying some of the following transformations:

  • (T1) - Translate right by 6 units

  • (T2) - Stretch by a scale factor of 13 parallel to the x-axis

  • (T3) - Translate up by 2 units

  • (T4) - Stretch by a scale factor of 5 parallel to the y-axis

  • (T5) - Translate right by 2 units

Which of the following could be a possible ordering of the appropriate transformations?

a
 (T2)→(T5)→(T4)→(T3)
b
 (T2)→(T3)→(T4)→(T5)
c
 (T1)→(T2)→(T4)→(T5)
d
 (T1)→(T2)→(T4)→(T3)
e
 (T2)→(T1)→(T4)→(T3)
